Frederiksværk-Hundested is a Danish municipality analyzed in the 2022–2023 Annual Report from the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database (AFDK), published by the Danish Regions' Clinical Quality Development Programme (RKKP) [^src1]. The report evaluates the clinical quality of atrial fibrillation treatment across all 98 Danish municipalities, functioning as a key benchmarking and quality development tool for the Danish healthcare system [^src1]. 

Within this context, Frederiksværk-Hundested is specifically noted for its data concerning stroke (apoplexy) events among atrial fibrillation patients [^src1]. This data contributes to the DanStroke-based calculations for Indicator 5, which tracks the prevention of ischemic strokes via anticoagulant therapy [^src1]. On page 93 of the report, the municipality appears in a detailed tabular breakdown with a "Ja" (Yes) designation and a specific set of statistical metrics: "4 / 955", "0 (0)", "0,4 (0,1-1,1)", "11 / 928", "1,2", and "2,1" [^src1]. Because the available corpus only contains this single tabular mention, no further historical, relational, or narrative details about the municipality are documented.
